assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial CUTOUT for an adult A1 English coursebook, genuine transparent background. ONE fictional woman about fifty years old, Helen, warm approachable expression, natural medium-brown wavy shoulder-length hair, ordinary modern clothing: a brick-red long-sleeve blouse and dark jeans. She is sitting on a simple slim wooden stool angled slightly toward the LEFT of the image, turned to the left as if remembering her childhood and answering an interviewer just off-frame. Full seated figure including knees, shoes and stool, clean complete silhouette, no cropped head or feet. She holds an old BLACK ROTARY TELEPHONE base securely on her lap with her left hand, and the connected handset in her right hand near her shoulder, not at her ear; the coiled telephone cord is visible and logically connected. She smiles thoughtfully, looking toward the empty left-hand page where her childhood memory will appear. Her adult face and the recognizable rotary dial must be crisp and readable. Natural photography, normal anatomy and five-finger hands; candid rather than commercial glamour. One physical telephone only, no extra objects, no desk, no scenery, no wall, no room, no text, no frame, no symbols, no border, no watermarks, no checkerboard pattern baked into the image. Isolate the woman, stool and telephone together on REAL alpha transparency. Soft natural light and restrained grounding shadow directly under stool/shoes only, no opaque backdrop. Portrait approximately 3:4 composition, with very small exterior transparent padding. The woman is a fictional adult remembering 1985, NOT a photograph of a child in 1985.

assets.prompt: A photorealistic editorial CUTOUT on genuine transparent background for an adult beginner English textbook partner interview. TWO fictional young adults in their twenties, a woman and a man from different ethnic backgrounds, sitting on two simple slim wooden stools turned toward each other. FULL seated figures, complete heads, knees, shoes and stools, nothing cropped. Composition tall, close but natural, their faces clear and large, no exaggerated empty space between them. Left person: young East Asian woman with straight dark shoulder-length hair in a plain lilac knit top and indigo jeans; she holds ONE small physical paper snapshot in her left hand at chest level with its back toward the viewer, and looks at her partner, smiling while remembering childhood. Right person: young Black man with short natural hair wearing a plain terracotta short-sleeve T-shirt, neutral charcoal trousers and white sneakers; he listens attentively with a relaxed friendly expression and one natural open hand near his knee. They are talking to each other, NOT facing the viewer, NOT looking at a phone. Small paper photo only, no smartphones or tablets. Hands normal anatomy and correct fingers. Natural daylight, real photographic skin and fabric, modest everyday clothing, warm candid interaction, no corporate handshake or stock-photo posing. Keep both people and stools isolated together, REAL alpha transparency surrounding the silhouettes, including the gaps between arms/legs/stools. No floor plane, no wall, no room, no scenery, no giant shadows, no frame, no text, no symbols, no logos, no watermark and no checkerboard painted into the picture. Approximately 4:5 portrait composition, minimal exterior transparent padding. This is a private childhood-memory conversation, not two real interviewees or the named Helen/Owen of the reading.
